title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-10-28) — an earnings gate: the Fed goes silent across the mega-cap reporting cluster
source: EST: DERIVED FROM THE BOARD'S OWN STATED RULE APPLIED TO A MEETING DATE FETCHED RAW THIS SESSION, then validated 16 of 16 against windows this repo already holds. THE RULE, as federalreserve.gov's blackout-period policy states it: the window "will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday." THE MEETING is federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm's 2027 panel, fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes), reading "October 26-27" with no SEP asterisk. 2027-10-26 is a TUESDAY, so the Saturday ten days earlier is 2027-10-16; the meeting ends Wednesday 2027-10-27, so the window closes at the end of Thursday 2027-10-28. THE VALIDATION, run over a census this session parsed rather than a spot check: 168 scheduled meetings were recovered from fifteen Board pages (the current calendar plus fomchistorical2007.htm through fomchistorical2020.htm, HTTP 200 each) -- exactly 21 years x 8 with no year off -- and the same arithmetic applied across it returns ALL EIGHT 2027 windows as this repo's recorded decode carries them (01-16, 03-06, 04-17, 05-29, 07-17, 09-04, 10-16, 11-27) AND ALL EIGHT 2026 windows as three sibling ledgers independently carry them (09-05 -> 09-17, 10-17 -> 10-29, 11-28 -> 12-10). Sixteen of sixteen. NO DECODE IS CLAIMED: this session did not re-run the blackout PDF's grid-shading decode, and does not need to -- the fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04 lane disclosed on 2026-09-06 that its own decode failed a 2026 control page (5 of 8 windows correct), so the family's standing lesson is that the arithmetic is the support and the decode is not trivially reproducible. Filed estimate because it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date -- fomccalendars.htm states verbatim that "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- so the promotion trigger is the 2027-09-14/15 meeting ratifying October 26-27, not a better fetch. Researched 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-06), which supersedes and shadows the two sibling proposals that discovered this event: fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16.from-consumer-confidence-2027-10-26.json and fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16.from-fomc-minutes-2027-10-06.json. Both were read first, per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md, and both agree with this derivation to the day; they stay where they are and become inert. THE STRUCTURAL FACT THIS EVENT EXISTS FOR, and it is a name the blackout family did not have. Measured against authoritative SEC 8-K Item 2.02 filing dates rather than this repo's macro calendar, the eight annual blackouts split cleanly into FOUR EARNINGS GATES and FOUR CLEAN GATES. The March, June, September and December windows contain ZERO mega-cap reports -- 20 of 20 years each, 80 of 80 window-observations -- because quarter-end reporting lags put mega-cap releases in the last third of January, April, July and October, exactly where the Committee's other four meetings sit. The January, April/May, July and OCTOBER windows carry three to five. All 10 of 10 realized October gates 2007-2025 swallowed at least three of AAPL/MSFT/AMZN: 2007 (3), 2008 (3), 2012 (4), 2013 (4), 2014 (4), 2015 (4), 2017 (5), 2019 (5), 2023 (5), 2025 (5). WHAT THE LEDGER MEASURED AND THEN REFUSED. This gate's geometry is unremarkable -- October-start meetings occur in 12 of 21 years, 2027's fourth-Tuesday start is the majority shape (7 of 12), and every realized October gate is exactly 9 sessions -- so there is no October equivalent of the September 2027 anomaly. What distinguishes it is content, and the content is why the family's accumulating overhang premium fails here: measured from ^GSPC daily bars, October's overhang session runs 1.025x mean / 0.641x MEDIAN its own October baseline, the lowest median in the family (June 1.379x, September 1.086x, December 1.141x), with 7 of 10 at or below 1.0x; its first post-gate session runs 0.970x / 0.697x. Both edges are sub-baseline in the year's SECOND-LOUDEST month (October 0.937%, behind only March's 1.047%). The tidier rival explanation -- that the gate lifts into month-end, which 2027-10-29 does -- was tested and REFUSED: it narrows to 1.013x vs 1.141x once October gates are dropped from the sample, and does nothing at all within October. TWO OPERATIVE DATES AND TWO DISMISSALS. The last legal Fed voice is 16:00 ET Friday 2027-10-15, which OCC's own 2027 expiration calendar (fetched this session) marks as October monthly opex -- routine, since the October gate's deadline is opex in 9 of 10 years structurally, and across all 168 gates the 57 opex deadlines show a VIX DROP (-0.361 vs +0.062), a post-expiration effect rather than a gate effect. The window holds nine uninterrupted sessions: NYSE's own 2027 column lists ten holidays, none in October, and no October early close. THIS LEDGER ALSO AMENDS A SIBLING ON THE RECORD: fomc-blackout-start-2026-10-17 records the window's middle as carrying "no tracked event at all" and routes the risk to the two edges; that is true of our macro calendar and backwards on the tape, where 7 of 10 October gates absorbed their mega-cap prints MID-gate. And the one framing this event was proposed for is already null -- the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 print inside this window was measured by its own lane at 0 of 9 across SPY/QQQ/XLY/XRT/AMZN/AAPL/XLF/TLT/VIX, and 0 of 9 again isolating blackout without an FOMC collision; it is cited, not re-derived. IMPACT MEDIUM AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: symbols is empty, a gate has no issuer and prints no number, and no house playbook is calendar-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped this session for 'blackout|columbus|month-end|monthly opex|earnings gate': zero hits in both). Estimates only widen caution and nothing here licenses an entry. Full stance, kill switches and three registered forward tests -- two of which score the structural split in WEEKS, on the 2026 October and December windows, rather than in the fourteen months this event is away: docs/research/events/fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16.md
